title: Lexxir Guild / Legacy Artificial Life Division
summary: Restricted record concerning an internal Lexxir Guild department associated with legacy artificial-life systems. The department's surviving documentation is incomplete.
body:
SUBJECT

LEXXIR GUILD / LEGACY ARTIFICIAL LIFE DIVISION

A restricted internal department of the Lexxir Guild is referenced in documentation concerning legacy artificial-life systems.

The department appears to have produced or modified artificial individuals before broader recognition of artificial sapience. Surviving records are incomplete and do not establish the full extent of its work.

One legacy model associated with the department is currently under active review.
